from pathlib import Path
import ast, importlib.util, itertools, random, re

path = Path('/work/textmask.py')
source = path.read_text()
compile(source, str(path), 'exec')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('textmask', path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

def original_masked(text: str, name: str) -> str:
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split('-')), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r'\b' + re.escape(tok) + r'\b', 'x', t)
    return t

# Focused contract checks.
assert mod.name_tokens('alpha-beta-alpha') == sorted({'alpha-beta-alpha', 'alpha', 'beta'}, key=len, reverse=True)
assert [len(x) for x in mod.name_tokens('aa-bbbb-ccc')] == sorted([len(x) for x in set(['aa-bbbb-ccc', 'aa', 'bbbb', 'ccc'])], reverse=True)
assert mod.masked('ALPHA beta alpha-beta an a', 'alpha-beta') == 'x x x an a'
assert mod.masked('AN an', 'an') == 'an an'  # tokens shorter than 3 remain
assert mod.masked('Alpha ALPHA', 'Alpha') == 'alpha alpha'  # matching remains case-sensitive
assert mod.masked('a.b A.B', 'a.b') == 'x x'  # regex metacharacters are escaped

# Compare against the pre-refactor algorithm over varied local cases.
names = ['', 'ab', 'alpha', 'alpha-beta', 'Alpha-beta', 'a.b-beta', 'one-one', 'x-y-zed']
texts = ['', 'alpha ALPHA beta', 'alpha-beta and alpha and beta', 'A.B a.b beta', 'one one-one', 'x y zed x-y-zed']
for name, text in itertools.product(names, texts):
    assert mod.masked(text, name) == original_masked(text, name), (name, text)
